title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Hero
desc: A barber encounters his ex-lover at a ruthless gang leader's hideout and attempts a daring escape, triggering a chaotic chase as goons pursue them relentlessly.

title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
desc: Five years after her husband vanishes, Vasudha rebuilds life as a single mother and finds love with Aarav. But when Hari unexpectedly returns, her world shatters as love and loyalty collide.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love but Pooja's death and family duty force them apart. Rajesh learns the truth and unites them, choosing love over obligation.

title: Jism
desc: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls for Sonia, wife of a wealthy traveler. She lures him into murdering her husband, but her shocking motive leaves Kabir stunned.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother, stays unmarried to keep peace in the family. But things get complicated when his younger brothers secretly try to make him fall in love.

title: No Entry
desc: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

title: Bhoot Bangla
desc: Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral legacy.

title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

title: Zeher
desc: Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Sholay
desc: Thakur Baldev hires Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar, the dacoit who wiped out his family. They find love along the way, but fate decides otherwise.

title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
desc: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the man Reena is set to marry, in an attempt to win her love - but he's unprepared for the chaos that follows when the truth comes out.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
